files.description: Read when the diff touches the core/adapter boundary, daemon routing, or the shared @core modules.
Read for TypeScript module shape — dependency injection, file-split seams, zod boundaries, helpers, and the @/ import aliases.
Read when the diff logs anything — levels, message style, and redaction.
Read only when the diff adds a config.toml key or a CARET_* environment variable.
Read only when the diff touches src/plan/rumdl.ts — the pinned rumdl version, its checksums, and the plan-formatting config.
Read only when the diff touches src/adapters/opencode/ or src/commands/install/ — the OpenCode adapter and its install path.
